# U-001 Widget detail (show) view + controller

## Goal
Ship the Widget detail page so a user can view a single widget.

## Context (read first)
The catalog module needs a read-only detail surface. The controller `show()` action
renders `resources/views/widgets/show.blade.php` with the resolved Widget model.

## Hard rules
- DO NOT add new composer dependencies
  Citation: starterkit-context.yaml §dependencies

## Implementation steps
1. Add `WidgetController@show` returning the `widgets.show` view.
2. Create `resources/views/widgets/show.blade.php` rendering the widget fields.
3. Add the render test (pack `## Test patterns` -> detail_view_render template):
   ```php
   $m = Widget::factory()->create();
   $this->get(route('widgets.show', $m))->assertOk()->assertSee((string) $m->name);
   ```

## Target files
```
app/Http/Controllers/WidgetController.php (edit — add show())
resources/views/widgets/show.blade.php (new — detail view)
tests/Feature/WidgetControllerTest.php (new)
tests/Feature/WidgetShowRendersTest.php (new — render test)
```

## Tests
- `test_show_route_renders_for_an_existing_widget`

## Acceptance
- ✅ GET /widgets/{id} returns 200 and renders the widget name
